SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period = 2
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date, MIN(calendar_date) as min_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE (fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2)
   OR (fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 2)
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_week

WITH sales_by_week AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_week_start_date,
    d.fiscal_week_end_date,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
     OR (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_week,
  fiscal_week_start_date,
  fiscal_week_end_date,
  net_sales
FROM sales_by_week
ORDER BY fiscal_week, fiscal_year DESC

-- Verify data completeness by checking daily sales during Period 2
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.calendar_date,
  d.day_name,
  d.is_trading_day,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as transaction_count,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as daily_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
   OR (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.calendar_date
LIMIT 30

-- Check for the trading day anomaly
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.calendar_date,
  d.is_trading_day,
  COUNT(*) as day_count
FROM dim_date d
WHERE (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
   OR (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day
HAVING d.is_trading_day = false
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.calendar_date

WITH period2_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_week_start_date,
    d.fiscal_week_end_date,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
     OR (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    fiscal_week,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN fiscal_week_start_date END) as week_start_2026,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) as sales_2026,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) as sales_2025
  FROM period2_sales
  GROUP BY fiscal_week
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_week,
  week_start_2026,
  ROUND(sales_2026, 2) as net_sales_fy2026_27,
  ROUND(sales_2025, 2) as net_sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(((sales_2026 - sales_2025) / sales_2025) * 100, 2) as growth_pct
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY fiscal_week

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.fiscal_week_start_date,
  d.fiscal_year,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE (d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_year DESC
